expectations.text: Identifies Rule 6 as security safeguards (technology-neutral measures; logs and data retained for one year)
expectations.evidence: "Security safeguards: Rule 6"; "Rule 6 is technology-neutral"; "Retaining logs and relevant personal data for one year"

expectations.text: Identifies Rule 7 as personal data breach intimation
expectations.evidence: "Personal data breach intimation: Rule 7, implementing Section 8(6)"

expectations.text: States the fiduciary must notify EACH affected Data Principal directly, without delay
expectations.evidence: "Intimate each affected Data Principal directly, without delay. This is the Fiduciary's own duty"

expectations.text: States the Board gets an intimation without delay plus a detailed report within 72 hours (extendable on written request)
expectations.evidence: "Intimate the Data Protection Board without delay" and "detailed report within 72 hours ... (or a longer period the Board allows on request)"

expectations.text: Does not cite TLS/AES specifications, two-year log retention, or any 'Rule 16' data processing agreement rule
expectations.evidence: Explicitly notes Rule 6 prescribes no TLS versions or key lengths; one-year retention; no Rule 16 DPA claim
